author: U_U_U_U_U_U_U_U
body:
First of all, sorry for my grammar, Im not very good with english, Im learning at school.
A few minutes ago I was playing in a normal day of Avicus when suddenly I got banned, Excesive Infractions, and Im pretty sure I did nothing, yesterday a mod warned me for auto-reporting me but thats all, now this mod come and with no reason ban me, If I am wrong please tell me what did I made. I think the mod that banned me is DaBederMC, something like that, I dont know him.

title: Ban appeal

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body:
Hello,

You were banned because you received over 10 punishments in the past 8 months. You have around 11 or 12 since November last year.
replies.body_tagged:
Hello,

You were banned because you received over 10 punishments in the past 8 months. You have around 11 or 12 since November last year.

replies.author: U_U_U_U_U_U_U_U
replies.body: So you took the time to check my profile and my infractions (without reason) just to ban me?
replies.body_tagged: So you took the time to check my profile and my infractions (without reason) just to ban me?

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body: I did have a reason. Our server doesn't allow users with over 10 or 20 infractions to come on the server for a certain period of time. I recall you from yesterday, and simply decided to check out your infractions, and I did so to some other users, too.
replies.body_tagged: I did have a reason. Our server doesn't allow users with over 10 or 20 infractions to come on the server for a certain period of time. I recall you from yesterday, and simply decided to check out your infractions, and I did so to some other users, too.

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
As Stated above, You have 10 infractions in a period of 8 months. This is unacceptable on our server and it results in a 30 day ban. Please think about what you have done on the server and fix your behavior once the tempban is over.

Regards,
Edans
